clue.text: First course requests under which they'll soon be off

definitions.meaning: read literally, the demands made by those ordering hors d'oeuvres or soup at a meal

definitions.text: under which they'll soon be off
definitions.meaning: the official's instructions in the moments before a race begins, after which runners set off

explanation.definitionFit: In racing, the runners are under the official's command at the line just before the off, an idiom also used for anything about to begin.

clue.text: Plebeian guy set off, aroused by love

indicators.note: off describes the letters as disordered or upset, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A common fellow is put out and then stirred by romance.
explanation.walkthrough: The fairy-tale princess sleeps until a prince's kiss wakes her, so she is the one aroused by love.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairy-tale princess lies in enchanted slumber until woken by a loving prince's kiss.

clue.text: A tourist trophy race — nearly time to draw

parts.note: TT is the Tourist Trophy, the Isle of Man motorcycle races

indicators.note: nearly means the word falls one letter short of complete

parts.note: taken as the word race before trimming

explanation.surface: A motorbike event on the Isle of Man is almost due to finish level.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' cuts the last letter from RACE to leave RAC. 'draw' looks like a tied result in a race but is the verb meaning pull in.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw people in is to pull them towards you, the same as luring or enticing them.

clue.text: What did you say is missing from Pandit Nehru's new game?

indicators.note: new means the letters are arranged into a fresh order
is missing from says the interjection's letters are absent from the name

parts.note: the name of India's first prime minister supplies the letter pool
eh? is the interjection asking someone to repeat themselves

explanation.surface: A question about what India's leader has lost from a novel pastime.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove E and H from PANDITNEHRU and rearrange the remaining PANDITNRU. The answer is an informal form of cricket in which a batter must run after every hit.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a casual variety of cricket where the batter has to run whenever the ball is struck.

clue.text: Island area to shake the world?

parts.note: to rock is to shake or sway to and fro
everything, the whole world, is all

explanation.surface: A question whether some place could make the entire globe tremble.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a tiny rock island in the North Atlantic that also names a sea area in the BBC's Shipping Forecast for sailors.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an uninhabited islet in the Atlantic and also a sea region named in British maritime weather bulletins.

clue.text: Defeat easily with expense about a penny

indicators.note: about places the first piece around the second

parts.note: an outlay is money spent, an expense
P is the abbreviation for a penny in British money

explanation.surface: Winning comfortably after spending only a coin's worth.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat an opponent by playing better than them is to defeat them, often with ease.

clue.text: First appearance of French qualification

parts.note: de is French for of
a but is a reservation or qualification, as in no ifs or buts

explanation.surface: A diploma from France being shown for the first time.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer's first public outing is called by this borrowed French word.

clue.text: Peg follows artist to renegade's home

indicators.note: follows puts the peg after the artist

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
a thole is a peg on a boat's gunwale acting as a rowlock

explanation.surface: A clothes peg is hung after a painter at a traitor's house.
explanation.walkthrough: A renegade is a rat in slang, so its home is a rat hole.
explanation.definitionFit: A traitor is called a rat, and a rat lives in a burrow or squalid den.

clue.text: Police job going from Los Angeles to London for building material

parts.note: the Great Wen is an old nickname for London
taken as written
cement binds bricks and is a building material

explanation.surface: An officer's transfer from California to the British capital to fetch supplies.
explanation.walkthrough: WEN for London is the Great Wen, William Cobbett's scornful name for the swollen city.
explanation.definitionFit: Upholding the law through policing is the work of the force and its officers.

clue.text: City subject is out of place

parts.note: EC is the postal district of the City of London
a topic is a subject of discussion

explanation.surface: A theme about the capital's financial centre seems misplaced.
explanation.definitionFit: Medically the word describes something located in an abnormal position, such as a pregnancy outside the womb.

clue.text: Hebrew girl needs to come in just a bit harder

indicators.note: the name comes in, sitting inside the run of words

explanation.surface: Someone needs to enter with slightly more force.
explanation.walkthrough: Tabitha is a woman of Joppa in the Acts of the Apostles, her Aramaic name meaning gazelle.
explanation.definitionFit: A biblical woman of Joppa, raised from the dead by Peter, bore this name.

clue.text: Obvious scheme to catch one

indicators.note: to catch means the plan holds the other letter within it

parts.note: a plan is a scheme
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A clear plan designed to trap someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Something evident or clear to see is described as being this, a synonym.

clue.text: Assign binder to one form of element

parts.note: to allot is to assign or allocate
a rope is something that binds

explanation.surface: Allocating a cord as one version of a chemical substance.
explanation.definitionFit: Graphite and diamond are examples: each is a distinct structural variety of the same chemical element.

clue.text: Sick aunt to get better temporarily, of course

indicators.note: sick suggests the letters are in a poor, disordered state

parts.note: taken as written
to rally is to recover briefly, as a patient sometimes does

explanation.surface: An ailing aunt has a brief improvement, as is to be expected.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean as one would expect, obviously or certainly.

clue.text: Female with a female bundle

parts.note: she is the female pronoun
she is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A woman along with another woman carrying a bundle.
explanation.definitionFit: A bound bunch of corn stalks or papers is a typical tied bundle.

clue.text: Black notes? Just so, circulating round tree

indicators.note: circulating means going around, so the first piece goes around the rest

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus, used to mean just so as written
a round thing is the letter O
Ulmus is the botanical genus name of the elm

explanation.surface: Asking whether dark musical keys move around a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Black notes' sounds like a piano's black keys but means music from Black American tradition.
explanation.definitionFit: This genre of popular music grew from African American gospel and rhythm and blues.

clue.text: Essayist and painter boycott holding company

indicators.note: holding means the ban encloses the other letters

parts.note: to ban is to boycott or prohibit

explanation.surface: A writer and an artist shun a firm.
explanation.walkthrough: Two famous Francises share the surname: the Elizabethan essayist and the twentieth-century painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Bacon the Elizabethan essayist and Francis Bacon the modern painter share the surname.

clue.text: See 22
Writer of music about sea foam is a browser

indicators.note: about places the composer's name around the foam

parts.note: Carl Maria von Weber was a German composer
surf is the foam of breaking waves

explanation.surface: A composer writing on ocean spray is someone who looks around.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who browses the internet moves from site to site, surfing the web.

clue.text: Now royal court on wagon, on spec, keeping donkey at junction

parts.note: to court is to woo
on the wagon means abstaining from drink, teetotal, TT
taken as written

indicators.note: keeping means the bet holds the donkey inside it

parts.note: something done on spec is a speculation or gamble, a bet
an ass is a donkey
a T is a junction shaped like the letter

explanation.surface: A tale of wooing on a cart with a gamble on a donkey at a crossroads.
explanation.walkthrough: The Wiltshire town gained the prefix Royal in 2011 for honouring soldiers repatriated through it, so it is now royal.
explanation.definitionFit: This Wiltshire market town was granted the title Royal in 2011, so its name now carries that prefix.

clue.text: See 17
Flourish to celebrate supporter's travel cost?

parts.note: a fan is a supporter
a fare is the price of a journey

explanation.surface: A trumpet blast for a fan's ticket price.
explanation.definitionFit: A short ceremonial flourish of trumpets greets a celebrated arrival or event.

clue.text: Diligent, detaining one pair seen as suspicious?

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: detaining means the outer letters hold the others inside

parts.note: sus is British slang for suspicious
I is the Roman numeral for one
a duo is a pair

explanation.surface: Someone hard-working holds a couple who look shady.
explanation.walkthrough: The inner pieces sit between the second and third S of ASSUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A diligent person is persistent and careful, working hard and steadily.

clue.text: Fancy being mother when entertaining sapper?

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the mother holds the sapper inside

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother
RE is the Royal Engineers, whose soldiers are sappers

explanation.surface: Imagining being a mum who hosts a military engineer.
explanation.definitionFit: A fancy is a whim or imagined wish, as is something one longs for.

clue.text: Card games in Italian monastery

parts.note: monte is a Spanish card game
cassino is a card game of capturing cards

explanation.surface: Gambling at cards inside an Italian religious house.
explanation.walkthrough: The abbey founded by St Benedict, destroyed in the 1944 battle, stands on a hill above the town of Cassino.
explanation.definitionFit: This hilltop abbey founded by St Benedict is the mother house of the Benedictine order.

clue.text: With some canvas around, get shot of deterrent

indicators.note: around means the canvas encloses the other letters

parts.note: a tent is a piece of canvas
to get shot of is to get rid of

explanation.surface: Wrapped in a tent, a weapon is discarded.
explanation.walkthrough: Trident is the UK's submarine-launched nuclear missile system, its nuclear deterrent.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's nuclear weapons system bears this name and serves as its strategic deterrent.

clue.text: Leaven's used to bind

indicators.note: used means the letters are put to work in another arrangement

explanation.surface: Yeast is employed to hold things together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' rearranges the letters of LEAVENS, the S of the possessive included.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone a slave is to bind them in servitude.

clue.text: Fortune held by left-winger as local funding

indicators.note: held by means the second piece is placed inside the first

parts.note: a communist is a left-winger
Tyche is the Greek goddess of fortune

explanation.surface: Luck is in the hands of a leftist, as a source of neighbourhood money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fortune' looks like a sum of money but is the goddess Tyche.
explanation.definitionFit: A fund raised for a neighbourhood's welfare is called by this name, as is a square in Monopoly.
